name: The blank ranks in Section B
subject: computing
brief: The spreadsheet script that assigns class ranks for the Class XI terminal marksheet works cleanly on Section A's forty rows, but on Section B it intermittently prints a blank rank cell whenever two students share the same aggregate total. Only one shared terminal in the commerce room has the script debugger installed.

causes.name: Some marks in Section B were entered as text strings with a trailing space
The tie-handling branch uses strict '<' instead of '<=' when advancing the rank counter
The lookup range is hard-coded to stop at row 35
The pre-sort routine sorts Section B in ascending order by mistake

tests.name: Inspect the printed Section B sheet to see whether every blank rank occurs on the second row of a tied pair
Read the six-line comparison block in the rank-assignment function
Print the data type and row index of each cell in Section B at the midpoint of the script
Step through the rank function on a synthetic two-row tied input of 412 and 412
Run the ranker on a manually pre-sorted table bypassing the sort routine

note: Set in the computer room at Nabapara Vidyalaya (loc_nhss). Section A has no tied totals and Section B has three tied pairs, so the fault shows only there. The rank loop advances its counter with a strict less-than where it needs less-than-or-equal, which leaves the second row of a tie unranked. Tracing the tied pair 412 and 412 and reading the six-line comparison block isolate it.
